key.name: streaming-mode
key.description: As you speak shows partial text in the field while you talk; When you stop injects the whole transcript once the utterance ends; Automatic picks per machine from the measured RTF table.

key.name: language
key.description: A BCP-47-ish code (en, fr, zh) for the language you dictate in. The backend skips language detection and decodes in this language; a code that does not match what is spoken degrades the transcript. Empty lets the backend decide.

key.name: hud-style
key.description: All four render the same calibrated audio envelope: Default is a level bar in the accent colour, Ribbon a flowing GPU wave, VU meter a segmented meter, Progress a plain progress bar.

key.name: silence-timeout
key.description:
With tap-to-start activation, end the dictation session on its own after this many seconds without speech. 0 keeps it running until the next tap. Hold-to-talk always ends with the key.
Also the interval feature 011-accessible-dictation-ux FR-018/FR-021 (project-plan T59) budgets for making an impending automatic end perceivable before it happens.

key.name: announcement-verbosity
key.summary: How much dictation state reaches assistive technology
key.description: all-transitions: every state change is announced (the default - anything quieter leaves a blind user with no feedback at all until they find this setting, feature 011-accessible-dictation-ux FR-004). failures-only: only errors/notices are announced. off: no proactive announcements, though the current state stays programmatically queryable at any time (FR-001).

key.name: sound-cues-enabled
key.summary: Optional short audible cues on session start/end/failure
key.description: Feature 011-accessible-dictation-ux FR-010. Always accompanied by an equivalent visual and assistive-technology signal; disabling this never removes the other channels.
